question: Can verifier-guided repair of the smallest decision-sufficient representation outperform one-shot synthesis and raw query selection?

frozen.external_verifier: exact finite enumeration of all hidden laws consistent with observations
frozen.certificate: selected query plus target-support set for each possible query outcome

interpretation.strong_positive: verified certificate reaches both strong thresholds and beats one-shot
interpretation.partial_positive: verified repair beats one-shot but misses one or both strong thresholds
interpretation.negative: verified repair does not beat one-shot
interpretation.next_if_positive: test reuse/transfer of retained certificate-construction policy without task-specific verifier hints
interpretation.next_if_negative: inspect whether failures are query search, support construction, or verifier-feedback assimilation
